summary: Introduction to the ansible-core 2.11 porting guide covering changes from ansible-base 2.10; ansible-core is for users who want a small set of collections, and regular users should install Ansible.
questions: What changed between ansible-base 2.10 and ansible-core 2.11?
Do I need ansible-core or the full Ansible package?

answer_card.title: ansible-base 2.10 → ansible-core 2.11 overview
answer_card.answer_md: ansible-core 2.11 is the successor of ansible-base 2.10. Use it alone only if you want a minimal, controlled set of collections; most users should install the **Ansible** package. Read the guide with the ansible-core 2.11 changelog.
